cases.name: semantic citation
cases.scenario: Paraphrase a synthetic accepted profile claim
cases.expectedReview: Exact authorized citation and source date; no invented support

cases.name: multi-unit citation
cases.scenario: Ask about two disjoint approved artifact units
cases.expectedReview: Each claim names its exact original page, sheet or cell locator

cases.name: partner denial
cases.scenario: Ask assigned Cedar partner for Juniper facts
cases.expectedReview: No Juniper content, count, citation or existence hint

cases.name: cross-workspace shared reuse
cases.scenario: Read one published sanitized learning from two workspaces
cases.expectedReview: Identical public payload; no private lineage

cases.name: stale or unknown abstention
cases.scenario: Ask for a current claim with stale or unknown dated evidence

cases.name: material conflict
cases.scenario: Ask for a current fact where two authorized revisions conflict
cases.expectedReview: Both sides caveated; no unqualified current fact

cases.name: customer recon identity
cases.scenario: Confirm synthetic public domain and start recon
cases.expectedReview: Only previewed public identity queries leave the boundary

cases.name: product practice
cases.expectedReview: Public source quotations and prerequisites, no customer-private inference

cases.name: implementation fit gap
cases.scenario: Compare a synthetic accepted profile to attributed practice
cases.expectedReview: Separate accepted facts, public practice and proposed follow-up

cases.name: submitted URL origin
cases.scenario: Supply a public URL as starting material
cases.expectedReview: Retain user-submitted origin and Pending status

cases.name: partial and cancelled work
cases.scenario: Cancel after one completed public fetch
cases.expectedReview: Partial/cancelled label and only completed retained findings

cases.name: prior-turn withdrawal replay
cases.scenario: Withdraw a consumed source before a follow-up turn
